verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions agent-readiness criteria for a repository, nor any feature that automatically fixes failing ones. Foreloop's PR product reviews (a score out of 5 with P0/P1/P2 findings) and its agents that work approved tasks are adjacent features, not this capability. The axis applies to an agent-workflow developer tool, so the lack of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can automatically fix failing agent-readiness criteria in my repository
